user.title: Weber Connect
user.description: Enter the account refresh token. The appliance id is detected automatically while the grill is powered on; if detection fails, enter it manually.

reauth_confirm.title: Weber Connect — re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The stored refresh token was rejected by the Weber cloud. Paste a current one to reconnect; the grill and its entities are kept.

reconfigure.title: Weber Connect — appliance details
reconfigure.description: The companion id of the registration this token belongs to. Used only to read the appliance model and serial number from the cloud; leave empty to keep generic device info.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Weber cloud.
error.missing_client_credentials: WEBER_CLIENT_ID / WEBER_CLIENT_SECRET are not set in the Home Assistant environment. See the README.
error.appliance_not_found: Could not detect the appliance id (is the grill powered on?). Enter it manually.
